items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer mentions Handy in context of Jelly Roll Morton litigation; Interviewee responds only about Jelly Roll Morton.

ctx.x: (Unintelligible) The music market place is revolting.

Harrison Smith who was one of the early, well a negro, a music publisher, and which promoter, he went into business in 1926, quite early for negro business, Handy was in before that, but nevertheless, still early. And right now he's in litigation with Jelly Roll Morton's estate.

And Jelly Roll owed him a great deal from some of his songs. Now this is his story, of course. Took some of his songs that he himself had written and sold them because he needed the money for something and Jelly Roll had a name at that time, you see.
